title: Node.js Backend Developer
summary: Node.js backend developers build the server-side code and APIs behind web and mobile apps using JavaScript or TypeScript on Node.js. They usually sit in a product team with frontend and mobile developers, often at startups, fintechs and e-commerce companies.
dailyDuties: Build and change REST API endpoints
Debug slow or failing requests from logs
Agree API contracts with frontend and mobile developers

skills.expectation: Build backend services in Node.js with Express or a similar framework, and understand the event loop
Write modern async JavaScript with promises and async/await
Write typed backend code in TypeScript
Design and build REST APIs with validation and error handling
Store data in a SQL or document database and write efficient queries
Store data in a SQL or document database and write efficient queries
Work with branches and pull requests
Write unit and API tests with Jest or Mocha
Use Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ or SQS for queues and events
Clear coding rounds that test data structures

groups.label: A database (SQL or a document store such as MongoDB)

certifications.why: Building and deploying apps on AWS
